ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 75% high-intensity (white/cream) pixels to 25% low-intensity (black/dark-grey) pixels across the visible ventral area.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Continuous high-intensity white regions occupy the central lobes; bounded by a low-intensity black perimeter along the trailing edge and a central dark vertical band widening towards the peduncle. Diffuse yellowish-tan mottling is present in the mid-lobe regions, with scattered dark punctate marks on the right lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, acute V-shaped depression with an approximate angle of 35-40 degrees; notch depth is approximately 15% of the total vertical height of the visible fluke.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations with varying pixel-amplitudes; the right lobe exhibits multiple deep, non-uniform indentations (notches) between coordinate clusters (x=700, y=200 to x=900, y=100) whereas the left lobe displays a more consistent, jagged serration profile.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Lobes exhibit a convex leading trajectory that terminates in sharp, upward-pointing distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-contrast, roughly circular white clusters (barnacles) localized at the extreme distal tips of both the left and right lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Distinct dark linear pixel disruptions visible: one horizontal stroke on the left lobe (mid-outer) and one vertical stroke on the lower right lobe near the central dark band.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Deep irregular notches on the trailing edge of the right lobe consistent with significant tissue loss; heavy barnacle colonization (Coronula diadema) concentrated on the lateral tips.
other_distinctive_markers: Extensive yellowish-tan surface discoloration (likely diatom film) covering approximately 30-40% of the visible high-intensity fluke surface.
